metadata.name: syndicate_program
metadata.description: Syndicate Solana/Anchor on-chain program: vault custody, deposits/claims/refunds, fees, and settlement RE-VERIFICATION via the shared deterministic core.

instructions.name: begin_live
docs: Advance Sealing → Live after button + off-chain seals are ready.

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pull-based, idempotent claim of a settled seat's payout.

instructions.name: create_match
docs: Create a match: bind fee config + the MatchConfig hash, open the vault, status → Filling.

instructions.name: deposit
docs: Deposit buy-in + entry fee → seat eligibility (the anti-spam gate, `05 §4`).

instructions.name: init_action_log
docs: Initialize the on-chain action log for replay after lock.

instructions.name: initialize_protocol
docs: Initialize the global protocol role registry and pause flags.

instructions.name: lock
docs: Lock the match: enough players present → seats frozen, status → Sealing.

instructions.name: refund
docs: Full refund of deposit **and entry fee** on VOID (no game, no fee — `04 §14`).

instructions.name: set_button_seed
docs: Record VRF output and derive the dealer button (once per match, at SEALING).

instructions.name: set_pauses
docs: Pause/unpause new exposure or settlement submission. Claims/refunds remain live.

instructions.name: submit_settlement
docs: Submit the final settlement. Replays the action log on-chain and re-verifies.
Pass the seats as `remaining_accounts`.

instructions.name: void
docs: Abort a match (insufficient players, oracle/timelock fault). Status → Void.

instructions.name: void_after_deadline
docs: Permissionless void after settle deadline (anti-censorship liveness).

instructions.name: withdraw_fees
docs: Withdraw accumulated entry fees + rake to the protocol treasury (post-settlement).

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Action not allowed in the current match status.

errors.name: SettlementMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement re-verification failed; funds will NOT be released (04 §18).

errors.name: ConservationViolation
errors.msg: Conservation check failed: payouts + fees != deposits.

errors.name: InvalidOracleProof
errors.msg: Pyth Receiver price update account/proof is missing, unauthenticated, or does not match the bound feed.

errors.name: InvalidSeat
errors.msg: Seat index is invalid or duplicated.

errors.name: SeatSetMismatch
errors.msg: Settlement did not include exactly the occupied seats.

errors.name: InvalidActionLog
errors.msg: Action log is invalid or not initialized.

errors.name: PredictionCommitmentMismatch
errors.msg: Prediction reveal does not match signed commitment.

errors.name: SettlementDeadlinePassed
errors.msg: Settlement deadline passed; use void/refund path.

errors.name: ButtonNotSet
errors.msg: VRF button seed has not been recorded.

errors.name: VrfSeedMismatch
errors.msg: VRF seed does not match the recorded match seed.

types.name: ActionLog
docs: Serialized engine + per-seat metadata for on-chain replay.

types.name: MatchAccount
docs: One match. Holds the fee config, the bound-config hash (replay anchor), running
totals, and the vault bump. Custody of funds lives in the associated `vault` token
account PDA.

fields.name: vrf_seed
docs: VRF output recorded at SEALING (audit/replay anchor).

fields.name: vrf_proof_hash
docs: Hash of the VRF proof bytes (provider-specific; recorded for audit).

fields.name: button
docs: Dealer button seat index, derived deterministically from `vrf_seed`.

types.name: ProtocolState
docs: Global protocol controls and role registry.

types.name: SeatAccount
docs: One player's seat in a match. `payout` is written during verified settlement; the
player then `claim`s it (pull-based, idempotent via `claimed`).

types.name: SeatIndexAccount
docs: One PDA per occupied seat index, preventing duplicate seat numbers in a match.

types.name: SettleArgs
docs: Settlement args — player states come from the on-chain action-log replay, not from trust.
